## Problem and change

Explain the problem, why it matters, and the behavior this change produces.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results. Identify checks that were skipped or
unavailable. For performance changes, include the baseline, model revision,
hardware, workload and numerical/output checks. Keep credentials and private
prompts out of logs.

## Review notes

Describe compatibility, memory, API, model-format or licensing effects that a
reviewer should assess. Link the related issue if one exists.

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and kept the change focused.
- [ ] I updated documentation and preserved applicable upstream notices.
- [ ] I included no secrets, private data, downloaded weights or build outputs.
- [ ] I distinguished synthetic/software-Vulkan results from physical GPU tests.

Only @jamesoneill may merge into `main`. Do not enable automatic merging.
